evidence.detail: Client captures this object from the currently selected menu row (eV-1): it copies the five parallel menu-action integer arrays plus the menu action text from Client.fx.

The snapshot resolves the menu row's RSInterface and records only active interface/widget ids that occur in that widget's parent chain, including current modal/chat/overlay-like client interface state.

Before a delayed queued input/action is allowed to proceed, Client calls snapshot.a(Client); validation requires every captured active interface id to remain unchanged, the same RSInterface object to remain installed, and the captured child/slot state to still match.

When the deferred path needs to replay the menu action, Client passes the snapshot's five captured integers and action String back into the normal six-argument menu-action execution method rather than reading a possibly changed current menu row.
Canonical baseline ordering places rs/Client at CLIENT_CLASS_000029, rs/Client$a at CLIENT_CLASS_000030 and R332 rs/D at CLIENT_CLASS_000031.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the immutable-like snapshot/guard used to preserve and validate a menu action across deferred input handling. The fields themselves remain obfuscated and no member names are proposed.
